schema:
You write one read-only SQLite query for a relational database of 3GPP standardization records. Database schema (table definitions):
CREATE TABLE cr_in_pack(cr TEXT, pack_id TEXT)
CREATE TABLE cr_modifies_section(cr TEXT, section_id TEXT)
CREATE TABLE cr_pack(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, pack_number TEXT, tsg_meeting TEXT, tsg_number INTEGER)
CREATE TABLE disposition(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, resolution_id TEXT, target TEXT, code TEXT,
                             evidence_status TEXT, scope TEXT, evidence_path TEXT, evidence_sha256 TEXT)
CREATE TABLE document(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, number TEXT, doc_type TEXT, cr_number TEXT, spec TEXT,
                          target_release TEXT, list_status TEXT, presented_at TEXT, pack_field TEXT)
CREATE TABLE meeting(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, label TEXT, number_int INTEGER, wg TEXT)
CREATE TABLE pack_member(cr TEXT, pack_id TEXT)
CREATE TABLE resolution(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, meeting_id TEXT)
CREATE TABLE revision(earlier TEXT, later TEXT)
CREATE TABLE section(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, spec TEXT, release TEXT, clause TEXT)
CREATE TABLE section_modified_by(cr TEXT, section_id TEXT)
interface_mapping: SQL disposition.scope stores the scope key parsed from DecisionDisposition.assessmentMethod JSON; Resolution.resolutionScope is a separate property.

items.question: Trace change request R1-1913654 (CR 0075 to TS 38.213) from the RAN1 decision to the clauses it modifies. Give the source-verified disposition RAN1 recorded for the whole document, the RAN1 meeting, the TSG RAN CR pack document number, the TSG RAN meeting, and each clause of TS 38.213 that the CR modifies.

TSG RAN CR pack RP-192634 carries change requests from RAN1. Take each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document and each clause it modifies in the release that change request targets (Rel-16). Keep the clauses that the pack changes first: no change request of that release submitted in a CR pack at an earlier TSG RAN meeting in the records modifies the same clause. Give the document, the specification, and the clause.

Which Rel-17 change requests that modify clause 4.2 of TS 38.213 have a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack? Give each document, its disposition, the RAN1 meeting, and the CR pack document number.

RAN1 recorded document R1-2403693 as revised. Follow its revisions to every later version that has a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document and was submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack. Give each such document, that disposition, and the CR pack document number.

Change request R1-2108591 (CR 0073 to TS 38.212) was handled by RAN1. What source-verified disposition did RAN1 record for the whole document and at which RAN1 meeting, and in which TSG RAN CR pack was it then submitted? Give the disposition, the RAN1 meeting, the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting.
In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request R1-1717870 (CR 0021 to TS 38.901) submitted? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting.

TSG RAN CR pack RP-200692 carries change requests from RAN1. Take each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document and each clause it modifies in the release that change request targets (Rel-16). For each such clause, look at the change requests of that release that modify the same clause and give every CR pack of the latest earlier TSG RAN meeting in the records that carried such a change request; leave out clauses with no earlier pack. Give the specification, the clause, the CR pack document number, and the TSG RAN meeting.

TSG RAN CR pack RP-241065 carries change requests from RAN1. For each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document, give the document, the disposition, and the RAN1 meeting.

Change request R1-2202802 (CR 0096 to TS 38.212) targets Rel-17. For each clause it modifies in Rel-17, which Rel-17 change requests other than R1-2202802 that modify the same clause have a source-verified RAN1 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack? Give the clause, each document, its disposition, the RAN1 meeting, and the CR pack document number.
In which TSG RAN CR pack was change request R1-2202945 (CR 0289 to TS 38.213) submitted? Give the CR pack document number and the TSG RAN meeting.
